_meta.purpose: Source, licence and required attribution of each canonical landscape delineation. Read by scripts/build_boundaries.py (GeoJSON feature properties; withholds the geometry when publish is false) and by mosaic_pipeline/stac_build.py (fields on the collection's boundary asset).
_meta.license_values: SPDX identifier when the licence has one, otherwise 'other' (same convention as the item licences). The terms are at license_url.
_meta.publish: false = the geometry is not written; the bbox is still derived and the collection cites the source instead. Since 2026-09-29 all 11 are published (Lizeth's decision; see the licence audit of 2026-09-28).
_meta.audit: Licence audit 2026-09-28 (internal report boundaries_licence_audit_2026-09-28.md). Values marked 'to be confirmed' wait for an answer from the person named in the report.

COL-CUM.source: Nine veredas of the Cumbal indigenous reserve area (Tasmag, Quilismal, Boyera, Cuaical, Cuaspud Grande, Llano de Piedras, Cuetial, Guan, San Martin-Miraflores), layer 'Cumbal_veredas_wgs84' compiled by Javier Ochoa (CIP). Original source to be confirmed.
COL-CUM.attribution: Vereda boundaries compiled by J. Ochoa (CIP) for the CGIAR Science Program on Multifunctional Landscapes; original source to be confirmed.

ETH-OG.source: Ethiopia River Basins (eth_basins), World Bank Group, World Bank Data Catalog dataset 0040202: Omo basin polygon (79,549 km2).
ETH-OG.attribution: Contains data from 'Ethiopia River Basins', World Bank Group (World Bank Data Catalog, dataset 0040202), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Changes: Omo basin polygon extracted, reprojected from Adindan / UTM zone 37N to WGS 84, trimmed near the Kenya border (about 255 km2) and simplified.

IND-CH.source: Composite outline: districts Jhansi (Uttar Pradesh), Tikamgarh, Chhatarpur, Damoh and Jabalpur (Madhya Pradesh) from a GADM district layer (GADM v2 attribute schema; same line work as GADM 4.1), and Mandla district (Madhya Pradesh) from the Survey of India district boundary layer with LGD codes (2021).
IND-CH.attribution: District boundaries: GADM (gadm.org) and Survey of India.

KEN-LEI.source: GADM 4.1, level 1: counties Kajiado (KEN.10_1), Kiambu (KEN.13_1), Machakos (KEN.22_1) and Makueni (KEN.23_1), unmodified.

KEN-LVB.source: GADM 4.1, level 1: counties Kakamega (KEN.11_1), Kisumu (KEN.17_1), Siaya (KEN.38_1) and Vihiga (KEN.45_1), unmodified.

MEK-3S.source: Mekong River Commission (MRC), 'Subcatchments of the Lower Mekong Basin' (Watershed Classification Project, October 2000; layer b_catlmb50): sub-catchments 43 Se Kong, 44 Se San and 45 Sre Pok.

PER-PCL.source: INEI referential census district limits (cartography of the V Censo Nacional Economico 2022; 'Distrital' layer, ide.inei.gob.pe): 11 whole districts of Coronel Portillo and Padre Abad provinces (Ucayali) and a clipped part of Calleria.
PER-PCL.attribution: Contains referential census district limits of the Instituto Nacional de Estadistica e Informatica (INEI), Peru (ide.inei.gob.pe); the limits are referential and have no demarcation value. Changes: districts dissolved into one outline, Calleria clipped, simplified. No licence is stated by INEI (to be confirmed).

SEN-FK.source: GADM: level 2 unit Fatick departement (GADM v2 attribute schema; geometry identical to GADM 3.6 and 4.1 SEN.3.1_1).

TUN-NW.source: Tunisia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB) v01, admin level 4, valid 2022-11-15; source Institut National de la Statistique Tunisie (INS), published by OCHA on HDX. Union of 7 sectors: Bousliaa, El Marja and Elles (Es Sers, Le Kef); El Ahouez Sud (Gaafour), Hammam Biadha Sud (El Krib), Chouarnia (Makthar) and Kesra (Kesra) (Siliana).
TUN-NW.attribution: Contains data from 'Tunisia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries' (COD-AB), source: Institut National de la Statistique Tunisie (INS), published by UN OCHA on the Humanitarian Data Exchange (https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-tun), licensed under CC BY-IGO 3.0. Changes: seven admin-4 sectors dissolved into one outline and simplified.

ZWE-MB.source: GADM 4.1, level 3: all 112 wards of the districts Mbire, Centenary/Muzarabani and Mount Darwin (Mashonaland Central) and Hurungwe (Mashonaland West), unmodified.
